rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something without embarrassment.

example.english: I unashamedly sing in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 我唔怕醜咁喺大家面前唱歌。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 paa3 cau2 gam3 hai2 daai6 gaa1 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1

rows.note: Use this when the speaker is brazenly doing something socially awkward or improper despite disapproval.

example.english: They unashamedly stay behind to eat even though everyone objects.
example.traditional: 佢哋明知大家反對，仲厚住面皮咁留低食飯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ming4 zi1 daai6 gaa1 faan2 deoi3 zung6 hau5 zyu6 min6 pei4 gam3 lau4 dai1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for openly and confidently displaying or doing something without trying to hide it, especially in a positive context.

example.english: I unashamedly tell people that I changed careers.
example.traditional: 我大大方方咁同人講自己轉行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 daai6 fong1 fong1 gam3 tung4 jan4 gong2 zi6 gei2 zyun3 hong4
